description: This file contains functions for computing the gradients of 1D, 2D, and 3D convolution operations with respect to input and weight tensors, primarily used in backpropagation during neural network training.

methods.name: conv1d_input( input_size, weight, grad_output, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1, )
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv1d with respect to the input tensor given the output gradient and convolution parameters.

methods.name: conv1d_weight( input, weight_size, grad_output, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1, )
methods.description: Computes the gradient of conv1d with respect to the weight tensor given the output gradient and convolution parameters.
